content: We also show the training loss curve for both the models having attention and attention combined with conflict respectively. Figure 4 and 5 shows these curves for Task 1 and Task 2 respectively. The curves are smoothed using moving average having an window size of 8. We notice that the conflict model has much steeper slope and converges to a much better minima in both the tasks. It can also be noticed that in the training procedure for the model which has both attention and conflict, the updates are much smoother.
